Recovery priority: H03.1 is the next ready core task after the unchanged O03.6 parent review. Consume docs/policy-process-qualification.md, docs/policy-catalog.md, docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md and docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.6.3/receipt.json. Qualified current artifact: target/service-release-o0363-final-20261015/sanctity-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.zip, SHA256 2a6324e498eef0ba278afc0ca6baada389305835235b9c861e85fc457177995e. The witness is independently authoritative; a backup is never proof of current policy.

Recommended implementation order under existing acceptance: (1) freeze the exact versioned catalog/blob bundle and O03.7 consumer contract, binding source/schema/artifact identities, required object inventory, supported capability fingerprint, installation identity and authenticated checkpoint/journal linkage; (2) implement catalog-consistent capture and bounded copy/retry with immutable manifests and atomic valid-set publication, preserving incomplete attempts as incomplete; (3) add isolated destination credentials/storage with no source-storage mount, scheduled execution/inventory and success/age/bytes/checkpoint diagnostics; (4) qualify ongoing writes, interrupted copying, missing/corrupt objects, restart/retry and cross-store access denial against the packaged artifact. Retain legacy compatibility evidence and make local-only/stale policy explicit without treating it as reopenable.

The existing scripts/backup-postgres.sh bundle-v1 has schema plus file digests only and copies the blob namespace after pg_dump; it lacks the new artifact/capability/checkpoint linkage and bounded scheduled isolated-store workflow. Retain independently held trust outside all catalog/blob backup sets. No recovery barrier release or restore opening belongs in H03.1. O03.7 remains blocked until H03.1 passes; O03.8 qualifies source-isolated recovery afterward. Local containers do not establish off-host or physical failure-domain durability (O03.3/SITE01).

Independent mode now requires PostgreSQL 17 transaction_timeout. The qualification repaired server-side phase drain in admission, finalization and live rollback resolution; the old client-only abort could leave active SQL alive until its statement timeout. Reuse the final artifact and its receipts, not the earlier diagnostic candidate.
